title: "ExDyn Sandbox: Response-only Sensitivity"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

## Overview

This report maps where the response-only classifier succeeds across the expanded sensitivity sweep and highlights the controls that most influence correct scenario identification.

```{r setup}
if (!requireNamespace("exdyn.sandbox", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    pkgload::load_all(export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop("exdyn.sandbox package is not available and pkgload is missing.")
  }
} else {
  library(exdyn.sandbox)
}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
store_path <- if (dir.exists("../_targets")) "../_targets" else "_targets"
sweep_results <- tar_read(sweep_results, store = store_path)
sweep_predictions <- tar_read(sweep_predictions, store = store_path)
sweep_f1_by_scenario <- tar_read(sweep_f1_by_scenario, store = store_path)
sweep_f1_by_archetype <- tar_read(sweep_f1_by_archetype, store = store_path)
sweep_macro_overall <- tar_read(sweep_macro_overall, store = store_path)
partial_files <- list.files(file.path("outputs", "partial_dependence"), pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
partial_png <- list.files(file.path("outputs", "partial_dependence"), pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
heatmap_dir <- file.path("outputs", "heatmaps")
heatmap_order <- file.path(heatmap_dir, c("alpha_vs_pred_speed.png", "mean_km_vs_presence.png", "allee_vs_pred_speed.png"))
heatmap_png <- heatmap_order[file.exists(heatmap_order)]
design_table_path <- file.path("outputs", "design_table.csv")
design_table <- if (file.exists(design_table_path)) readr::read_csv(design_table_path, show_col_types = FALSE) else tibble::tibble()
```

Overall response-only macro F1 (hold-out): **`r sprintf("%.3f", sweep_macro_overall)`**.

## Scenario and Archetype Performance

```{r f1-tables}
knitr::kable(sweep_f1_by_scenario, digits = 3, caption = "Macro F1 by scenario (response-only)")
knitr::kable(sweep_f1_by_archetype, digits = 3, caption = "Macro F1 by archetype (response-only)")
```

## Partial Dependence on Controls

```{r partials}
if (length(partial_files)) {
  partial_tbls <- purrr::map(partial_files, ~ readr::read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(source = basename(.x)))
  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(partial_tbls)
  knitr::kable(head(combined, 20), digits = 3, caption = "Sample of partial dependence tables")
  purrr::walk(partial_png, function(path) {
    cat("### ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)), "\n\n", sep = "")
    knitr::include_graphics(path)
    cat("\n\n")
  })
} else {
  cat("Partial dependence artefacts missing; rerun `tar_make()` to regenerate.")
}
```

## Failing Regimes (Bottom Decile)

```{r failing}
if (nrow(sweep_predictions)) {
  predictions_aug <- sweep_predictions %>%
    left_join(sweep_results %>% select(exp_id, dispersal_mean_km, pred_speed, effort_strength,
      allee_A_over_K), by = "exp_id") %>%
    mutate(correct = as.numeric(truth == estimate))
  bottom_runs <- predictions_aug %>%
    group_by(exp_id, species, scenario, alpha, dispersal_mean_km, pred_speed, presence_rate, effort_strength, allee_A_over_K) %>%
    summarise(correct = mean(correct), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(correct)
  take_n <- max(1, ceiling(nrow(bottom_runs) * 0.1))
  bottom_runs <- bottom_runs %>% slice_head(n = take_n)
  knitr::kable(bottom_runs, digits = 3, caption = "Bottom decile runs by correct-classification rate")
} else {
  cat("Predictions not available.")
}
```

## Design Guidance

```{r design-table}
if (nrow(design_table)) {
  knitr::kable(design_table, digits = 3, caption = "Design guidance summary")
} else {
  cat("Design guidance table missing; rerun `tar_make()`.")
}
```

> Guidance: focus on parameter ranges with macro F1 ≥ 0.8; use the heatmaps and partial dependence curves to tune dispersal, observation rate, and front speed in future designs.
